tei:div.tei:p: 221)chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs tig las: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lo rgyus me tog chun po mdzes pa'i phreng ba bzhugs so: na mo gu ru rde wa ḍā ki ye: (Dakini Secret letter here) dpal mchog dang po kun bzang rdo rje 'chang la phyag 'tshal lo: chos dbyings 'dus ma byas pa'i rang bzhin rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga yangs pa'i mkha' klong: rang byung rnam par dag pa'i zhing mchog 'og min bde chen dhu ma tha la chos dbyings mtha' dbus dang bral ba'i gnas su: ston pa kun tu bzang mo la 'khor rang byung ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid mkha' 'gro ma rigs lngar rang rang gi rigs kyi mkha' 'gro ma bye ba 'bum dang bcas pa la: brjod bral bde stong zag pa med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi ngang las rang bzhin sgyu 'phrul nges pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo rgyun mi chad pa bskor zhing: gdangs snang 'gags pa med pa'i ye shes kyi rol pa las gnas kyi 'og min dur khrod gsang chen rol par rnam kun mchog ldan rdo rje phag mo'i skur bzhengs shing: ru tra la sogs pa ma rungs gdul dka'i 'gro ba rnams 'dul ba'i phyir du chos kyi dbyings las drag mo'i skur bzhengs: gzhan yang 'og min gyi gnas lnga 222)dang sku gsum rang byung gi mkha' 'gro'i zhing la sogs pa nas gnas yul dur khrod he ru'i gnas rnams su mkha' 'gro yongs 'dus kyi ngo bor bzhugs shing: sprul pa zhing rdul grangs mnyam gyis 'gro ba'i don rgya chen po mdzad do: khyad par bod gangs can dang 'jig rten spyi'i bstan 'gro'i don du nyid las mi gzhan pa'i sprul pa dbyings yum lha lcam sgrub pa'i rgyal mo bde chen mthing 'od 'bar ma la sogs pa 'gro ba'i ded dpon chen po 'byung ngo: de lta bu'i gdams pa khyad du 'phags pa mkha' 'gro'i thugs bcud 'di ni bdag bde chen zhi ba mtshos lus longs spyod dang rin po che sna tshogs thabs shes tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i maṇ+ḍal phul nad phyi rabs las can rnams kyi don du zhus shing:

zab mo'i gter du rgyas btab nas dus la babs tshe brda 'grol gyi smon lam btab pa ma 'ongs snyigs ma lnga bdo ba'i dus su gsang sngags kyi drod rtags chung zhing nus pa nyams pa dang: grub gnyis kyi dngos grub phra zhing rtsa rlung khrom du bsgrags pa: zab don khyim par 'chad cing rang gzhan phung la sbyor ba sogs snyigs dus kyi rtags mtshan ma nges pa 'byung ba'i dus su: gter bdag dbyings yum sgyu 'phrul kun dga' de wa su kha pa shaṃ sogs rim bzhin 'byung 223)zhing gter nas bton te bstan dang 'gro ba'i don rlabs so che 'byung bar nges so: 'di nyid nyams su len pa'i gang zag rnams ni 'brel tshad don dang ldan cing 'phral du mkha' 'gros rjes su bzung zhing byin gyis rlabs nas thun mong gi dngos grub grub pa brgyad dang mchog tu rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi'i sa thob nas gang 'brel bcas pa rang snang don gyi 'og min chos dbyings chen por nang gsal gzhon nu bum skur grol bar byed pa'i zab lam khyad par can no: skal ldan sems kyi bu dang 'phrad par shog: bka' srung gnod sbyin gza' dang ma mos srungs shig gnyer ro dam rgya: skal med log lta'i 'gro la sku gsung thugs kyi rgya yod do: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: brda thim: : ces pa 'di yang 'khor lo'i mgon po gter chen chos kyi rgyal po'i bka' bskul phebs tshe 'khor 'bangs kun gyi tha shal ba mdo med 'khrul zhig su kha badz+ra gyis dben gnas rdo rje yang rdzong gi nye 'dabs nas mkha' 'gro gsang ba'i 'phrul brda las zhal bshus pa'o: lo rgyus kyi mjug gi: zab lam khyad par can no: zhes gsungs pas: da lan 224)gyi skabs su bab pa rdo rje phag mo'i sku'i gnas dung ral brag dkar nas rten 'brel phun sum tshogs pa dang bcas te gdan drangs pa'i zab gter mkha' 'gro gsang ba 'dus pa'i don dbang skal ldan rjes 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la:

sogs dbang gi lhan thabs ltar ro: 225)mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus cha lag: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs bde chen mchog stsol bzhugs so: bkra shis so: 226) na mo dz+nyā na ḍā ki ye: skye med dbyings yum chos sku kun bzang mo: rang gdangs ma 'gags 'od lnga'i rang bzhin du: thugs rje'i rtsal snang mdzad pa bsam mi khyab: sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la gus pas 'dud: de yang ye shes mkha' 'gro sgrub pa'i thabs: spros bcas sku tsaka mkha' 'gro'i gtor ma dang: bhan thod tshad ldan dngul dkar me long la: sin+dhu ra yis ha ri ni sa bam̐: chos 'byung zur lnga'i nang du bris nas kyang: da la'i dbus bzhugs mchod rdzas dpag med bkod: spros med rnal 'byor rang gi spyod dang bstun: dang po sbyor ba sngon 'gron skyabs sems ni: na mo: skye med ka dag klong chen por: 'gags med rang gsal mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: rang dang 227)gnyis med 'ub chub klong: 'du 'bral med par skyabs su mchi: hoḥ gnyis snang sbubs su 'phyan pa'i 'gro: rang byung ye shes rtogs pa'i phyir: smon 'jug don dam byang chub sems: bskyed nas sangs rgyas sar 'god shog: lan gsum bya: yan lag bdun pa ni: hrīḥ snang srid dag pa rab 'byams klong: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du: sgo gsum dad pas phyag 'tshal lo: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul: gnyis snang 'dzin pa dbyings su bshags: dge tshogs kun la rjes yi rang: theg chen bla med chos 'khor bskor: rgyal kun 228)mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs: 'khor gsum dmigs bral dbyings su bsngo: tram̐ gu ru rat+na maṇ+ḍa la pū dza hūm̐: bka' bsgo ba ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ nga ni dpal chen he ru ka: drag gtum rngams pa'i skur gsal nas: 'od dang 'od zer 'phros pa yis: gnyis snang 'dzin pa'i gdon bgegs rnams: chos dbyings ngang du mtshams bcad do: oṃ hrīḥ pad+ma ti kṛ ta sogs: hūm̐ phaṭaḥ hūm̐ bzhi sogs kyi bskrad:

srung 'khor ni: hūm̐: rang nyid lhar gsal thugs ka nas: ye shes lnga ldan 'od zer 'phros: rdo rje rang gzugs 'khor lo lnga'i: gur khang chen po'i rwa bas bskor: gnyis snang gdon gyis glags mi rnyed: srung ba'i 'khor lo rab tu brtan: bh+rūm̐ badz+ra rak+ṣa ham̐'u?: dam bzung ni: hrīḥ rang rig ye nas sangs rgyas la: rang zhal so mar mjal ba'i phyir: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs rnams: rang bzhin gnyug mar dam bca' 'o: badz+ra tsit+ta a: byin 'bebs ni: hūm̐ hrīḥ sku gsum dag pa'i zhing khams nas: brgyud gsum rig 'dzin mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren byin chen phobs: rnal 'byor sgo gsum byin gyis rlobs: dbang bzhi bskur 229)la rgyas gdab mdzod: mchog thun dngos grub ma lus pa: da lta nyid du bstsal du gsol: oṃ dz+nyā na ḍā ki ni sa ma ya a be sha ya a āḥ mchod rdzas byin brlab ni: hrīḥ snang srid rnam dag mchod pa'i rdzas: phyi nang gsang ba'i tshogs rnams kun: chos nyid rol pas rgyas theb cing: kun bzang mchod sprin lta bur gyur: oṃ ma hā sarba pū dza hoḥ bshags pa ni: hoḥ rang sems ye nas sangs rgyas la: glo bur gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pas bsgribs: lha dang gnyis su 'dzin pa rnams: gnyis med klong yangs chen por bshags: sa ma ya shud+dhe āḥ gnyis pa dngos gzhi lhar gsal ni: āḥ ka dag zang thal skye ba med: lhun grub rang gdangs snying rjer shar: rtsal snang sgyu 'phrul rol pa las: gzhal yas khang pa'i mtshan nyid rdzogs: de dbus pad+ma nyi zla'i steng: rang rig thugs srog bam̐ yig las: 'od zer 'phro 'dus yongs gyur pa'i: skad cig rang nyid gsang ba'i ma: bde chen dkar mo zhal gcig pa: bzhad pa'i nyams dang spyan gsum ldan: phyag gnyis g.yas pas cang te'u 'khrol: 230)dpa' bo dgyes bskang dngos grub stsol: g.yon pas dngul dkar dril bu 'dzin: ye shes lha yi thugs rgyud bskul: bcu drug dga' ba'i bzhin ngoms shing:

nu ma 'bur zhing bha ga rgyas: gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan drug gsol: dar dpyangs rin chen mdzes pas brgyan: zhabs gnyis gar stabs pad zlar bzhugs: rin chen dbu rgyan snyan cha sogs: ut+pal dmar po'i do shal 'phyangs: 'ja' 'od lnga ldan 'od zer 'phro: rtsa gnas rigs lnga'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs: ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs par gsal: dam tshig ye shes gnyis med par: 'ub chub ngang du dbyings nas bskul: dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ spyan 'dren ni: hrīḥ 'og min chos dbyings zhing khams nas: skye med rgyal ba kun gyi yum: ye shes mkha' 'gro bde chen dkar: ḍā ki bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: sgrub mchog sgo gsum smin pa dang: mchog thun dngos grub bdag thob mdzod: oṃ dz+nyā na ḍā ki ni bam̐ ha ri ni sa badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ bzhugs gsol ni: hūm̐: dam tshig ye shes gnyis med par: 'od gsal ting 'dzin dag pa yis: ye nas du ma 231)ro gcig ngang: gnyis med mnyam nyid ye shes klong: dag par bzhugs nas dngos grub stsol: ḍā ki ni tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra: phyag 'tshal ni: na mo: ka dag rtsa bral stong pa'i dbyings: ye shes rang gdangs ma 'gags pa: rig 'dzin rnam bzhi lhun grub pa'i: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs la: sgo gsum gus pa chen po yis: rang ngo mjal phyir phyag bgyi'o: na mo pū ru sha ya ho: mchod pa ni: hrīḥ snang dang srid pa'i phun tshogs kun: kun bzang nam mkha' mdzod du 'bul: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs dang: de bzhin nyid mchod ma lus pa: rgyal yum mkha' 'gro'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ dz+nyā na ḍā ki ni sa pā ri wa ra ar+ghaṃ sogs: shap+da ma hā gu h+ya sarba pū dza ho: bstod pa ni: hoḥ bde stong ye shes bskyed pa'i ma: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo mchog: bde chen dkar mo'i lha tshogs la: mi phyed dad pa chen po yis: sku gsung thugs yon phrin las lnga:

mi bzad rgyan 'khor chen po la: rab gus dad pas phyag 'tshal bstod: grub gnyis dngos 232)grub dpal thob shog: 'dzab dgongs ni: hrīḥ rang nyid mkha' 'gro'i thugs ka ru: thugs srog bam̐ḥmathar sngags g.yon 'khor: 'od zer yar 'phros rgyal kun mchod: thugs rje byin rlabs nus pa bsdus: 'od zer mar 'phros skye 'gro yi: las nyon bag chags ma lus bcom: thams cad bde la 'god par bsam: snang grags lha sngags ting nge 'dzin: ma yengs mi bsgom chos sku'i klong: ma bcos gtad med rgya yan ngang: dkyil 'khor gsum gyi rol par bzla: oṃ dz+nyā na ḍā ki ni bam̐ na ri ni sa sarba sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: de ltar ting 'dzin so ma'i ngang: smra bcad mi tshig ma 'dres par: bye ba bzlas pas mkha' 'gro 'grub: rab dngos 'bring nyams rmi lam du: shel g.yu ut+pal dkar po sogs: gzhan gyis sbyin dang rang gis rnyed: rtags mtshan mi 'dra du ma yong: gsang bar sbos la nyams su longs: 'grub par 'gyur ba the mi tshom: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas gsum pa rjes rim tshogs mchod la: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du: 'du ba tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i phyir: thabs shes rdzas dang dza gad skyems: bza' bca' btung sogs thod rnga'i sgra: rkang gling rol mo dbyangs dang bcas: tshogs rdzas nam mkha' mdzod du spel: 233)lha yi ting 'dzin gsal ba'i ngang: byin gyis brlab pa 'di ltar bya: hūm̐ hrīḥ snang srid dag pa rab 'byams klong: rang byung mtshan ldan ka pa la: yangs shing rgya che'i snod nang du: thabs shes rdzas ni phun sum tshogs: zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor sprul: kun bzang mchod sprin lta bur gyur: ram̐ yam̐ kham̐ḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐: ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum brjod: spyan 'dren ni: hrīḥ 'og min mkha' la spyod pa'i zhing: rang byung lhun grub gzhal yas nas: ye shes mkha' 'gro bde chen dkar: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas: 'du ba tshogs kyi 'khor lo ru:

sgyu ma chu zla'i zlos gar bzhin: gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: thabs shes pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs: gnyis med yid kyi mchod pa 'bul: dam ye dbyer med ro gcig gyur: oṃ dz+nyā na ḍā ki ni badz+ra sa ma ya dza dzaḥ sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: tshogs phud 'bul ba ni: āḥ rang byung bde chen thod snod du: thabs shes longs spyod 'dod yon tshogs: zag med kun bzang mchod sprin ltar: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha la 234)'bul: dgyes bzhes bde stong dngos grub stsol: oṃ dz+nyā na ḍā ki ni ga ṇa tsakra pū dza khā hiḥ bskang ba ni: hrīḥ snang yul dag pa mchod pa'i rdzas: bde stong ye shes cho 'phrul las: gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya chos: dza gad skyems dang rol mo sogs: sman gtor rak+ta lha mor bcas: kun bzang mchod sprin chen po 'dis: ye shes dbyings kyi mkha' 'gro ma: bde chen dkar mo'i thugs dam bskang: 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i= yang sprul bye ba'i= nyams chags sgrib pa dag par mdzod: thun mong grub pa brgyad dang ni: mchog tu rig 'dzin rnam pa bzhi: 'bad med lhun grub sa thob shog: bshags pa ni: hoḥ rgyal yum mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs dgongs: bdag cag ma rig las dbang gis: gsang ba bla med dkyil 'khor du: bskyed bzlas ting 'dzin g.yel ba dang: sgo gsum bag med ci bsags pa: tshogs kyi mchod pas bskang zhing bshags: dag tshangs mchog thun dngos grub stsol: oṃ ga ṇa tsakra satwa sogs: āḥ tshogs rol ni: hoḥ bla med gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du: thabs shes rdzas ni longs spyod 235)ldan: tshims pa drug ldan blang dor med: rol pas dngos grub rnam gnyis thob: a la la hoḥ zhes rol: lhag ma ni: pheṃ bh+yo: gnas dang yul gyi zhing khams nas: lhag la dbang ba'i tshogs rnams kun: lhag gtor bshal chu 'di bzhes la: bar chad kun sol phrin las sgrubs: sarba u ts+tshiṣ+ṭa bā liṃ ta khā hiḥ bskul pa ni: hūm̐ bh+yo: dbyings nas bzhengs shig mkha' 'gro'i tshogs:

bskul lo phrin las drag po bskul: gsang ba bla med bstan pa la: gnod pa'i bdud bgegs thal bar rlog: gsang sngags bstan pa dar ba dang: bstan 'dzin tshe bsrings dngos grub stsol: las bzhi'i phrin las 'grub par mdzod: chad tho ni: hūm̐: sku gsum mchog gi dkyil 'khor du: gsang sngags bsrung bar khas blangs shing: rnal 'byor skyong bar zhal bzhes ltar: bka' srung gter srung dam can tshogs: gtor ma 'di bzhes rnal 'byor pa'i: 'dod don phrin las 'grub pa dang: mtha' 'dre gdug pa'i bsam sbyor bzlog: rgyal bstan dar rgyas yun brtan mdzod: bstan ma ni: bh+yo: gangs can 236)bod yul sprul pa'i zhing: pad+ma rgyal po'i dam gnas pa'i: bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor bcas kyis: zag med mchod gtor 'di bzhes la: lta log bdud kyi bstan pa bsnubs: gsang sngags bstan pa dar rgyas mdzod: ma ma hrīṃ hrīṃ ba liṃ ta khā hiḥ bro mnan ni: hūm̐: e las thar med hom khung du: bdag 'dzin ru tra dam nyams sri: rig pa ye shes chen pos mnan: stong nyid klong nas bro brdung zhing: spros bral dbyings su rgyas gdab bo: 'od gsal klong du s+t+waṃ bha ya: mā ra ya nan: ces mchod bstod bya zhing lhag chad bskang: dngos grub ni: hoḥ gsang ba ye shes dkyil 'khor du: bde chen dkar mo'i gsang ba gsum: ji bzhin bdag gis bsgrubs pa yi: mi bzad rin chen yid bzhin gter: ma lus sgo phyes dngos grub stsol: nad med bde ba'i dngos= 'chi med tshe yi= bde stong mchog gi= mchog thun phrin las lhun grub nas: rig 'dzin rnam bzhi'i sa thob shog: rtsa sngags mthar: kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi pha la hoḥ gshegs bsdu ni: hrīḥ gdod nas dag pa'i 237)gzhi klong nas: ye shes dam tshig gnyis med par: gtso 'khor dag mnyam chen po ru: chos nyid don la gshegs bzhugs bral: don dam gzhi klong badz+ra muṃ: rjes thob 'khor lo gsum gyi ngang: sku gsum rol pa'i ngang nyid du:

skad cig snang stongs chu zla ltar: ka dag klong du sa ma dhi hūm̐: bsngo ba ni: hoḥ gsang ba bla med dkyil 'khor du: dmigs bcas dmigs med dge tshogs kun: ma gyur 'gro ba kun don du: byang chub chen por yongs bsngo bya: kun kyang srid pa'i gnas stongs nas: gdod ma'i rgyal sa zin par shog: smon lam niḥ kyai: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i dkyil 'khor du: bsod nams tshogs chen bsags pa'i mthus: bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa: rang rig ka dag don rtogs nas: stong pa chen po'i ye shes kyi: zung 'jug 'od gsal mngon gyur nas: zab mo bla med don dam mchog: rang grol chen por sangs rgyas shog: bkra shis ni: hrīḥ srid zhi'i dpal yon phun sum tshogs: 'dod dgu'i bkra shis gang lags pa: ye shes mkha' 'gro'i mthu stobs kyis: bdag cag rnams la bkra shis 238)shog: ces dang bkra shis ci rigs bya: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: e ma: skye med rang byung rig pa'i rang gdangs nas: ma bcos lhun grub rang rtsal dpe ru shar: re dogs bral ba'i klong nas yi ger bris: gter min gter 'dras sa steng khyab pa'i dus: rang gzhan gnyis phung chos log mang du dar: de tshe dbyings kyi rje mo thugs khros nas: sad ser mu ge nad mtshaun la sogs dar: bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tsher bar chad mang: de phyir bdag cag ma rig dbang gis ni: nor 'khrul lhag chad 'gal ba gang mchis pa: sprul pa mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la bzod par gsol: sgrib med dag cing mchog thun dngos grub stsol: dge bas 'gro kun byang chub sa thob shog: ces pa mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs 'di'ang dus bzang 'brug gi lor dbyar zla bzhi pa'i nyer lnga'i nyin su kha'i ming gis bris pa dge legs 'phel/ bskul ba po 'jigs med phrin las rnam rgyal lo//
